result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_selected_node_ids()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get currently selected node IDs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8134-L8165){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_selected_node_ids() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Get selected node ids](/assets/graphs/get-selected-node-ids.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Six nodes labeled by their integer ids 1 to 6, with nodes 2, 4, and 6 selected in the accent color. get_selected_node_ids() returns the list of those ids, 6, 4, 2, in no guaranteed order." width="100%"} Returns the list of node IDs that are currently marked as selected. Order is not guaranteed. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of selected node IDs, empty if no nodes selected. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} In a 5-node star, only the hub has degree `3` or higher, so it's the only node selected: ::: {#36292dc3 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_star_graph(5) .select_nodes_by_degree(min_degree=3) ) graph.get_selected_node_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [1] ``` ::: :::
